title: Kan Maqaan Mana Rasuulaa Keessatti
intro: Mana ergamaa isa dhumaa keessatti lubbuu seenaan dhuunfaa ishee amantoota hundaaf barumsa waaqa ta’e jiraatte. Jireenyi nama kanaa ajaja jijjiiramaa aadaa hawaasummaa bara baraan irra deebi’ee bocee wajjin walitti hidhata guddaa qaba ture, kunis amantiin maatii fi kan ta’uu akkamitti akka ibsu irratti jijjiirama guddaa agarsiisa.
clues: Maqaan koo yeroo tokko hidda dhaloota kabajamaa wajjin kan wal qabate taʼus, dhugaan ol aanaan boodarra hidhata amantii isa dhugaa ifa godha.
Rabbii fi ergamaa Isaa irraa tola guddaa argadheera, tola Kitaaba keessatti ifatti labsame.
Jireenyi gaaʼelaa koo qormaata guddaa ilaalcha hariiroo guddifachaa ilaalchisee qabu bara baraan jijjiiru taʼe.
Ani nama qormaanni dhuunfaa koo ajaja waaqaa erga ani deemeen booda Nabiyyiin dubartii akka fuudhu hayyamutti nama geessu ture.
Seenaa kootiin garaagarummaan maatii baayoloojii fi maatii filatame dhaloota hundaaf ifa ta’eera.
Hiriyyoota koo keessaa ani tokkicha maqaan koo mul’ata isa dhumaa keessatti ifatti mul’ate, akka raajiitti osoo hin taane, akka hojjetaa qoramee fi kabajameetti.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
